items.informal_name: Linear Map Applied to Linear Combination Distributes Over the Combination
items.informal_description: For any linear map $ f : M \to M' $ between $ R $-modules and any finite support function $ l : M \to_0 R $, applying $ f $ to the linear combination $ \sum_{m \in \text{support } l} l(m) \cdot m $ yields the linear combination $ \sum_{m \in \text{support } l} l(m) \cdot f(m) $. In symbols: $ f\left(\sum_{m} l(m) \cdot m\right) = \sum_{m} l(m) \cdot f(m) $.

items.informal_name: Linear Combination of Vectors Indexed by α over R
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_5) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {M' : Type u_8} [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M'] [inst_4 : Module R M'] (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (v : α → M) (l : α →₀ R),
  f ((Finsupp.linearCombination R v) l) = (Finsupp.linearCombination R (⇑f ∘ v)) l
items.informal_description: The linear map from the space of finite support functions $ \alpha \to_0 R $ to the $ R $-module $ M $, which sends each finite support function $ l $ to the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } l} l(i) \cdot v_i $, where $ v_i $ denotes the vector associated with index $ i $.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_4 : Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) {ι : Type u_4} {g : ι → M} (l : ι →₀ R),
  f ((Finsupp.linearCombination R g) l) = (Finsupp.linearCombination R (⇑f ∘ g)) l
items.informal_description: For any linear map $ f : M \to N $ over a semiring $ R $, index type $ \iota $, function $ g : \iota \to M $, and finite support function $ l : \iota \to_0 R $, it holds that $ f\left( \sum_{i \in \text{support } l} l(i) \cdot g(i) \right) = \sum_{i \in \text{support } l} l(i) \cdot f(g(i)) $.

items.informal_name: Linear combination of vectors indexed by α over R
items.type:
{α : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    (R : Type u_5) →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : Module R M] → (α → M) → (α →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M
items.informal_description: The linear map from the space of finite support functions $ \alpha \to_0 R $ to the module $ M $, which sends each finite support function $ d $ to the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} d(i) \cdot v_i $, where $ v_i $ denotes the vector associated with index $ i $. This map is constructed using the linear equivalence of summing scalar multiples of individual vectors embedded via the right scalar multiplication operation.

items.informal_name: Composition with Linear Map Preserves Linear Combinations
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_5) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {M' : Type u_8} [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M'] [inst_4 : Module R M'] {v : α → M} (f : M →ₗ[R] M'),
  Finsupp.linearCombination R (⇑f ∘ v) = f ∘ₗ Finsupp.linearCombination R v
items.informal_description: For any linear map $ f: M \to M' $, the linear combination of the composition $ f \circ v $ equals the composition of $ f $ with the linear combination of $ v $, i.e., $ \text{linearCombination}_R(f \circ v) = f \circ \text{linearCombination}_R(v) $.
